weekEntries.notes: Establish roots. Light feeding. CalMag from day one in coco.
Full veg feed. LST if not already done.
Introduce BioBloom early. Autoflowers may begin pre-flower.
Transition. Taper BioGrow, increase BioBloom. Introduce TopMax.
Full flower. Watch humidity drop to prevent bud rot.
Taper CalMag. Check trichomes. Begin flush prep.
Plain pH'd water only. EC of runoff should approach input EC.
Final flush. Harvest when trichomes are where you want them.
Early veg/seedling. Mix FloraMicro first, then Gro, then Bloom.
Late veg peak strength before photoperiod flip.
Early bloom stretch (Week 1 Flower). 1:1:1 base ratio.
Pre-flower formation (Week 2 Flower). Step down FloraGro.
Mid bloom (Week 3 Flower). Bud site establishing.
Late bloom swell (Week 5 Flower). FloraGro completely dropped.
Ripening phase (Week 6 Flower). Tapering base feed.
Final flush with plain pH-adjusted water.
Mid bloom. Introduce Big Bud Coco.
Late bloom. Switch Big Bud to Overdrive.
Switch to Bloom A+B at photoperiod flip.
Early bloom stretch. Start Athena PK.
Early veg. Always mix equal amounts of Cocos A and Cocos B.
Introduce Green Sensation (1ml/L). Reduce base feed to maintain EC.
Mix 1 tab per 5L coco coir. Soak with Bactrex (1g/L) + CalMag.
Water with plain tap water + CalMag.
Water with plain tap water + CalMag.
Substrate prepped with 1 tablet per 5L. Initial soak with Bactrex (1g/L).
Mid-flower boost: 20ml Orgatrex + 1g Bactrex per plant in 500ml water.
Optional light late-flower Orgatrex boost if leaves show premature yellowing.
Mix 3g BioGrow per Liter substrate into soil. Water with Enhancer (0.5g/L).
Top-dress 3g BioBloom per Liter substrate into topsoil.
Light top-dress booster (1g/L) for long flowering cultivars if needed.
